[PREFERENCE] User is looking for recommendations for a cashew-based cheese sauce similar to the one used in their lasagna.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a recipe for a creamy cashew-based cheese sauce for mac 'n cheese, including ingredients and instructions.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Ingredients for the cashew cheese sauce:  
- 1 cup of cashews  
- 1/2 cup of water  
- 1 tablespoon of lemon juice  
- 1/2 teaspoon of salt  
- 1/4 teaspoon of black pepper  
- 1/4 teaspoon of nutritional yeast  
- 2 tablespoons of olive oil  
- Optional: 1/4 cup of non-dairy milk  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for using the cashew cheese sauce in mac 'n cheese and suggested experimenting with spices and seasonings.
